protocol.step1: User writes title + body (title ≤ 80 chars, body ≤ 4,000 chars).
protocol.step2: Client computes SHA-256 of body. Builds payload: { type: "pc-publish-v1", title, body, sha256, timestamp, address }.
protocol.step3: Beacon wallet signs the payload (v1 stores the unsigned shape; next iter calls client.requestSignPayload).
protocol.step4: Signed payload persists to browser localStorage + POSTs to /api/publish (KV-backed when PC_PUBLISH_KV is bound).
protocol.step5: When the PointCast Dispatch FA2 contract lands, a batch process mints an NFT per queued payload, with the signature as provenance + IPFS copy as tokenURI.
